title: Execution Stage Anchor v0.1
description: The execution stage ledger's anchor (Thomas 2026-09-30, docs/proposals/EXECUTION_STAGE_ANTI_ROLLBACK_V0.1.md D1 a): the row the machine last reached, kept out of the governance-state backup so a restore cannot bring it back together with the rows it would vouch for. The row it names must be on the chain and at most one row behind the tip; otherwise the stage reads READ_ONLY (ROLLED_BACK, ANCHOR_MISSING, ANCHOR_TAMPERED, ANCHOR_BEHIND).
